About_desc.Desc_1: Hello! My name is Judit and I have nine years of experience in software development. I have an MSc degree in Computer Sciences and Mathematics (2004, University of Debrecen, Hungary).
About_desc.Desc_2: During my career I worked as a software developer for more than seven years in the cheminformatical and medical fields.
About_desc.Area_1: Computer graphics: visualizing large datasets (volumetric data)
About_desc.Area_2: Contributed to the development of the worldwide known chemical molecule visualization and editor software written in Java. Focused on UI design, enhancing user experience and interface functionality.
About_desc.Area_3: Licensing: Solely responsible for the re-design and implementation of the company’s licensing system. Worked collaboratively with all developer teams and the sales department.
About_desc.Desc_4: I also performed in the Scrum Master role for two years. In this role I have worked closely with the company's management and agile coaches, enhancing the collaboration between developer teams, helping them understand and accept changes more easily.
About_desc.Desc_5: After dedicating 8 years to full-time childcare I realized that teaching children is the profession I can truly commit to. Therefore after obtaining my degree as Certified Teacher of Mathematics and Computer Science, I will be teaching at an elementary school. My goal is to foster a love for mathematics and computer science and provide high-quality education for the next generation of children.
